end.summary: Practised physical changes: no new substance; changes in shape, size, or state.
end.parentNote: Ananya practised identifying physical changes using haircuts, melting ice cream, and melting ghee. They explained that melting changes the state but not the substance. There was an initial mix-up about dissolved sugar being gone or chemically changed; this was corrected later when Ananya stated that sugar is still present and the mass remains 220 g. At home, ask Ananya to sort examples into physical or chemical changes and explain whether a new substance forms.
